scope: Preliminary validation only; reserved test labels and scores not accessed

protocol.informativeness_fit: train similarities and train labels only
protocol.tuning: clean TUNE partition of validation only
protocol.reporting: disjoint REPORT partition of validation; no retuning

partition.assignment: Sort clusters by SHA256(seed:cluster_id); first floor(fraction*n) -> TUNE
partition.crossing_pairs: Exclude pairs whose endpoints fall in different partitions; preserve official files.

protocol.selection: max F1, then precision, then higher threshold; parameter ties retain grid order
protocol.ablation_policy: Inherit full-model gamma and penalty; reselect only threshold on clean TUNE. Also report removal with the full-model threshold frozen.
protocol.legacy_diagnostics: Original raw-channel scores; legacy adaptive gamma=.5/1/1.5 and penalty=0/.10/.25 grid. Unequal tuning budget; descriptive diagnostics only.

missingness.mechanism: SHA256(seed:field:offer_id), independent uniform masking; a pair loses the feature if either offer is masked
missingness.thresholds: Frozen at clean-TUNE values for all REPORT masks

warnings: Product clusters overlap; this is expected for the official seen-model train/validation protocol.
integrity.warning: Product clusters overlap; this is expected for the official seen-model train/validation protocol.
integrity.signature_definition: SHA256 of JSON [title, description, brand] after Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse; all-missing excluded. Titles also checked separately.

missingness.mechanism: Offer-level masking of description and brand only

limitations: Seen-model fallback validation cannot establish generalization to reserved unseen-model test.
Cluster-disjoint TUNE/REPORT discard crossing negative pairs, change class prevalence and difficulty; not directly comparable to official full-split benchmark scores.
Single deterministic partition; no generalization confidence interval or proof of superiority.
Reliability coefficients are manual sensitivity assumptions, not empirically validated source reliability.
Informativeness is global field discriminativeness, not value-specific information content.
Title and identifier remain correlated views of the same source even inside a shared budget.
Only description and brand are masked; seed standard deviations describe masks, not sampling uncertainty.
Metrics classify supplied pairs and do not measure end-to-end retrieval recall.

metadata.validation_selection_reason: Official additional 80cc100un/small validation rejected: 110 training offer IDs, 27 training pairs, and 250 training clusters overlap; empirical unseen-cluster fraction is 0.500000; failed checks: ['train__unseen_validation']. Official original seen validation retained verbatim; no rows filtered.
metadata.test_access: This runner accepts no test argument and opens only train and selected validation. Separate preparation checks reserved-test identity metadata only.
